name: satin-pro-styles
title: Satin Pro styles
description: Satin Pro's own classes and component CSS, precompiled: only what Satin styles doesn't already have. Import it after satin.css.

utilities{.sa\:z-20{z-index:20}.sa\:mx-1{margin-inline:var(--sa-spacing)}.sa\:-ms-2{margin-inline-start:calc(var(--sa-spacing) * -2)}.sa\:mt-3{margin-top:calc(var(--sa-spacing) * 3)}.sa\:mt-px{margin-top:1px}.sa\:w-44{width:calc(var(--sa-spacing) * 44)}.sa\:cursor-grabbing{cursor:grabbing}.sa\:p-1\.5{padding:calc(var(--sa-spacing) * 1.5)}.sa\:ps-\[30px\]{padding-inline-start:30px}.sa\:pt-0\.5{padding-top:calc(var(--sa-spacing) * .5)}.sa\:line-through{text-decoration-line:line-through}@media (hover:hover){.sa\:hover\:text-text-muted:hover{color:var(--sa-text-muted)}}.sa\:data-dragging\:bg-bg-popover[data-dragging]{background-color:var(--sa-bg-popover)}.sa\:\[\&_svg\]\:text-text-destructive var(--sa-duration-slow);transform:translateY(8px)}.satin-bulk-roll{display:inline-grid;overflow:clip}.satin-bulk-roll>*{grid-area:1/1}.satin-bulk-roll[data-dir=up]>[data-roll=out]{animation:satin-bulk-roll-out-up var(--sa-ease-out)}.satin-bulk-roll[data-dir=down]>[data-roll=out]{animation:satin-bulk-roll-out-down var(--sa-duration-fast) var(--sa-ease-out)
